privacyPolicy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacyPolicy.intro: As Sabah Towers, we guarantee the privacy of personal data of users visiting our website.

items.title: 1. Data Collection and Usage
items.description: When you fill out contact forms, the provided name, surname, phone number, and email address, as well as automatic cookie indicators, are collected. This data is used solely for the following purposes: informing you about apartments, prices, and sales terms; responding to your inquiries and contacting you; improving website performance and user experience.

items.title: 2. Data Sharing and Security
items.description: Your personal data is not sold or rented to third parties. Information may only be shared with third parties as required by law or with trusted partners providing technical support to the website (subject to confidentiality).
